name: algo-akanade-react-core
description: Shared React hook wrapping @algo-akanade/connector's login/chat/confirm lifecycle — message history, send(), confirm(), loading/error state. Uses only the React hooks API, so the exact same code runs under React DOM (websites) and React Native (same underlying 'react' package) — algo-akanade-react and algo-akanade-react-native both render UI on top of this one hook.
